truth (retro lint-dashboard-write-save Δ1, issue #821): a -ux part that writes station state with a
request Context (a Context or WebOp declared in the file) and no save anywhere in the module FAILs once per write
line: .set(, .add(, .remove(, .invoke( whose last argument is that Context, and any addSpecialEvent(. A call whose
last argument is no request Context (a list add, a null-Context write, a one-argument remove) is no write here; a
write in a comment or a string literal is not code. The shape of a dashboard that shipped three releases without
a save path.

@DIR@/Mod

exit 1

-- Mod/Mod-ux/src/com/x/ux/CommandInvoker.java --
package com.x.ux;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
final class CommandInvoker {
  static void invokeSet(BComponent point, BValue arg, WebOp op) {
    Action set = point.getAction("set");
    point.invoke(set, arg, op);
    // point.invoke(set, arg, op); in a comment is not code
    String s = "point.invoke(set, arg, op)";
  }
}
-- Mod/Mod-ux/src/com/x/ux/ScheduleWriter.java --
package com.x.ux;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
final class ScheduleWriter {
  static void write(BComponent schedule, BComponent day, BComponent events, BValue out, Context cx) {
    java.util.List<String> rows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    schedule.set("defaultOutput", out, cx);
    day.add(start(), finish(),
        out, cx);
    rows.add(name(out, 1));
    events.remove("ev1", cx);
    schedule.addSpecialEvent("h", out, null);
    rows.remove(0);
    point.set("x", out, null);
  }
}
